title: Choose Site
prompt:
Screen 1: Choose site
Title: "Where are you working?" (28px bold, left-aligned, deep navy #0F1B2D).
Background: warm off-white #F6F3EC.
Strict rules:
- Readable at arm's length! Minimum text 18px, body 20px, labels 18px.
- No decorative icons. Lots of whitespace: 24px padding inside cards, 20px between cards.
- Two large tappable cards:
  Card 1: "Organization A" (bold 22px, simple clean card #FFFDF8, 1px border #D9DEE4, 12px radius, large touch area min 72px tall).
  Card 2: "Organization B" (bold 22px, clean card). One of them can show an active selection state (e.g., Organization A selected with navy border).
- Below the cards: one large text field with 18px label: "Your name". Input height 56px, 18px text, placeholder "e.g. Sundaram". No password field.
- Fixed at the bottom: One primary button full width, 56px tall, warm orange #C2540F with white text, font size 18px bold: "Continue".
- No other elements, no IDs, no timestamps. Ultra-clean.

title: Register - Choose Type
prompt:
Screen 2: Register – choose type
Top bar: site name "Camp A – Govt. High School", volunteer "Sundaram", status strip "Offline · 12 waiting to sync".
Bottom navigation: Register (active), Search, Matches, Priority. Simple line icons.
Page title: "Register" (28px bold).
Readable at arm's length. Minimum text size 18px, body 20px.
Two very large stacked buttons/cards (min 90px tall each, 24px padding, 20px margin between cards):
Button 1:
- Primary text: "Person found here" (22px bold, #0F1B2D)
- One line of helper text: "Someone who has arrived at this site" (18px, secondary #44505F)
Button 2:
- Primary text: "Looking for someone" (22px bold, #0F1B2D)
- One line of helper text: "A family member is searching" (18px, secondary #44505F)
Nothing else on this screen. No extra buttons, no badges, no technical text. Generous spacing.

title: Register - Speak
prompt:
Screen 3: Register – speak
Top bar with back arrow or simple nav, shows title of chosen type: "Person found here" (28px bold).
Sub-status or connection strip: "Offline · 12 waiting to sync".
Readable at arm's length (min text 18px, body 20px).
Layout:
In the center of the screen:
- One very large round microphone button, exactly about 160px by 160px (circle with warm orange #C2540F or deep navy background, containing a clean white SVG line microphone icon).
- Clear bold label directly under/in it: "Tap and speak" (22px bold).
- Under the button, a short helpful example in grey text (18px, #6B7280): "Say: name, age, village, father's name, what they are wearing".
- Note/indicator showing recording state or pulse, or timer "0:08 · Tap to stop".
- Below the mic area with generous margin: A plain text link (20px, #1F6497, underlined or clean text): "Type instead".
- STRICT RULE: No form fields on this screen. No extra badges, IDs, or timestamps. High contrast, generous whitespace.

title: Verify Details
prompt:
Screen 4: Verify details
Title: "Check the details" (28px bold).
Rules: Arm's length readability. Min text 18px, body 20px, field labels 18px. One primary button at bottom.
Content:
1. Top: A small grey box (#EFECE6 or #E8E5DD, 16px padding, 12px radius) showing the spoken transcript:
   "Transcript: Murugan, around 35 years old, male, from Kilvelur, father Ramasamy, wearing blue shirt and black pants" (18px text).
2. Filled fields in a single column, large and tappable to edit:
   - Field: Name -> Value: "Murugan" (52px tall box, 20px text)
   - Field: Gender -> 3 large chips: [Male (selected)], [Female], [Other] (each 48px+ tall, 18px bold text)
   - Field: Age band -> 4 large chips: [Under 12], [12–18], [19–59 (selected)], [60+] (48px tall, 18px text)
   - Field: Village -> Value: "Kilvelur" (52px tall box, 20px text)
   - Field: Father's or spouse's name -> System is unsure about this field! Has an amber outline (2px solid #B7791F) and a clear amber tag/note: "Please check" (18px text, #B7791F) with value "Ramasamy".
   - Field: Clothing or marks -> Value: "Blue shirt, black pants, scar on left eyebrow" (52px tall box, 20px text)
3. Large photo button: "Add photo" (56px tall button or dashed card with camera icon, 18px bold).
4. For "Person found here": one extra question card:
   "Is anyone from their family missing?" with two large toggle chips: [Yes] [No (selected)].
5. Bottom fixed primary button: Full width, 56px tall, warm orange #C2540F with white 18px bold text: "Save".
No IDs, timestamps, or technical jargon. Generous 20px vertical spacing.

title: Suggested Matches

- Background #F6F3EC, cards #FFFDF8 with 1px border #D9DEE4 and 12px radius, 24px padding inside cards, 20px gap.
- Remove all mentions of cryptographic signing, biometrics, DNA, audio calls, protocols, task forces, node names, and ID numbers.
- No decorative icons except in the bottom navigation.
CONTENT ON MATCHES SCREEN (SHOW ONLY THIS):

   Inside Card 1:
